notes.title: May 13 - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes for Decamped on May 13th:

[list]
[*] Added a control tab to the options - Set mouse sensitivity and bindings for select actions
[*] Added loading screens between levels
[*] Fixed some collision issues
[*] Movable object rotation and objective fixes
[*] Fixed some puzzle sequencing issues
[*] + several other fixes
[/list]

We hope this fixes most of the problems players were having, but are still monitoring potential issues. Thank you for your support!
